REALMBOUND

THE LIVING GUILD · ISEKAI SIMULATION
V22 · THE STONE CROWN

A world that runs itself: adventurers pick their own contracts, the settlement grows from outpost to grand city on its own, and everything saves to your device. Take up the sword yourself — armies, dungeons, bosses and a realm that ages through eras await.

◆ MOVETOUCH ANYWHERE ON THE LEFT — THE STICK RISES UNDER YOUR THUMB. KEYBOARD: WASD OR ARROWS.
◆ FIGHTHOLD THE BIG BUTTON TO AUTO-ATTACK · DASH THROUGH DANGER · THE WAR CRY RALLIES EVERY HERO NEARBY.
◆ THE EAGLE EYEPINCH TWO FINGERS TO SOAR ABOVE THE REALM — TWO FINGERS ALSO DRAG THE WORLD, AND THE WHEEL ZOOMS ON DESKTOP.
◆ GROWTHE HALL RUNS ITSELF: CELIA THE GRAND STEWARD HIRES, BUILDS, TRADES & SENDS AGENTS — TAP HER FOR THE LEDGER, TAP ANY NPC TO WATCH THEM LIVE. THE CITY SAVES ITSELF.
◆ WHAT'S NEW — THE PATCH CHRONICLE ◆

THE ENDLESS AGES — v13: THE WORLD NEVER STOPS EVOLVING. The realm now moves through five AGES of its own making — EMBERS, CROWNS, ARCANA, STEEL & SKY, CHAOS — each turning on time itself: day 60 or three wars crowns the powder age; guild rank 15 or a finished academy ignites the magic revolution; day 200 raises the railways; and the Demon King's fall unleashes the endless CHAOS. The kingdoms SIMULATE between your wars — populations grow, heirs come of age, kings die, regencies rule, houses fall in civil war, borders drift with the seasons, and a fourth hidden kingdom steps from the mist. Your GUILD AGES too: heroes retire into trainers, founding blades hand their skills to recruits, and every deed is written into a named-year CHRONICLE ("Year 14 — the Year of the Ash Bloom") that the elders still quote generations later. THE DEMON KING ARC unfolds in four phases — probing, heralds, the march, and the MAHOU-OU himself at the Obsidian Gate — and when he falls, the RANKED THREAT LADDER takes the throne: Void Sea Leviathans, Fallen Angel Hosts, the Previous Mahou-ou (he resurrects stronger if slain carelessly), Ancient Dragon Calamities and rival OTHERWORLDERS — every one READS YOUR SAVE, resists your favorite damage type and fields legions counter-picked against your dominant class, two calamities pressing two kingdoms at once. And when an age ends, ASCEND: the guild master transcends, the guild endures as an NPC legion, and a fresh D-rank adventurer rises through the old halls — bloodlines, monuments and retired legends stacking forever. The loop never closes.

THE CLARITY PATCH — v12: THE EAGLE EYE — pinch two fingers to climb above the realm; words keep their size at any height, and the whole map fits one gaze. THE GREAT RIVER runs deeper and wider, its bridges now MEASURED to the true water — decks, rails and stone abutments grow with the river's girth, and the king's roads are the only place they stand. THE CLARITY RIG — every button finds its rightful home: the war cry joins your thumb's arc, the zoom cluster roosts beside the map, the system grid tucks under it, and the gazette stacks clean beneath the HUD. The MINIMAP learns the river, its bridges and your heading; the sky chip counts the days; and this very page becomes a field manual.

THE LIVING ECONOMY: three kingdoms — VALDORIA, KARAZ-HUL and the AKEMI SHOGUNATE — trade along the king's roads. Merchant caravans buy low and sell high while bandits stalk the passes; every tree, boulder, pond and beast is a harvestable node feeding real production chains — wheat to flour to bread, ore to ingots to forged steel. Prices breathe with supply, demand and the turning seasons; fish the ponds, shear the sheep, cook at your tavern, and press M for the world map.

THE AGE OF GUILDS: every kingdom keeps its own guild hall — the ORDER OF THE GOLDEN BANNER, THE IRON PACT and THE BLADE CIRCLE. Earn their trust and their champions join you: PALADINS, BERSERKERS, SAMURAI and NINJA walk from their halls into your roster. Caravans beg the board for ESCORT GUARDS; villages cry out when RAIDERS strike the fields — answer the DEFEND contracts or watch their markets burn. Sow SEEDS in your farm plots, buy VENTURE STAKES in foreign markets, and rise through the CONSORTIUM of merchants. THE LEGENDS UPDATE: the REALM GAZETTE reports every twist of the world — press H or the paper button for the news. WORLD LEGENDS rise on the roads: GRAVEBARK the elder treant, VAELTRAX the frost wyrm and SHIRAKAGE the oni warlord stalk the kingdoms — rally your guild and slay them for royal bounties. Four new heroes walk into the hall: DRUIDS, MONKS, BARDS and ENGINEERS. Tame a WOLF COMPANION with a wolf heart, and earn DEEDS & TITLES worthy of the guild master's legend.

ASCEND, GUILD MASTER: press G to rise as a TIER SSS GOD — no blade, beast, bolt or curse can ever harm you again; your touch strikes with divine force and your presence mends your heroes. Press V to open THE EYE OF THE GOD — a cinema seat above the world: follow your adventurers, rivals and wolf as they camp, trade, raid, duel and hunt, at up to 3x speed.

THE AUTOMATION ERA — v7: DEMON TREES are now true nocturnal predators: they STIR with a fair warning, lash with vines, and can be wrestled free with a dash — chop a wounded one before it burrows to heal! THE SKY LIVES: spring rains feed the fields, autumn fog emboldens the demon trees, winter snow slows the world. BUILD GUILD BUSINESSES — bakery, forge works, alchemy lab, tavern and trading post — that eat stockpile goods and pay coin every market turn. Outfit idle heroes on the EXPEDITION BOARD and watch the gold come home. The WANDERING HERALD files fresh news from every road. And the FOURTH CHARTER walks through your gates: SPELLBLADE, BEAST TAMER, ALCHEMIST and FROST WITCH.

THE ARTISAN AGE — v8: six WORKSHOPS hum inside your hall — TANNERIES, TAILOR LOOM, FIELD KITCHEN, ALCHEMY BENCH, SMITHY and the ENCHANTER'S DESK. Artisan heroes refine the stockpile ON THEIR OWN into thread, cloth, leather, steel, glass vials, runes and cut gems — then forge FINE GEAR that permanently sharpens every hero, and BREW POTIONS & HOT MEALS that fly straight to wounded or hungry heroes in the field. Every craft rolls quality — CRUDE, FINE or a MASTERWORK worthy of the Herald's front page. A GREAT RIVER now winds through the realm: wooden bridges carry the king's roads, and the old WATERMILL turns day and night. Lampposts ring the plaza, wells and market stalls line the square, and a fenced FARM DISTRICT ripens south-east of the hall. NEW BEASTS roam the wilds: milk-giving GOATS, dam-building BEAVERS, strutting PEACOCKS, moonlit LUNA MOTHS spinning luna silk, and the legendary EMBERFOX whose burning pelt is the prize of a lifetime. And the FIFTH CHARTER answers the call: RUNESEEKER, STORMCALLER and SHADOWBLADE bring rune prisons, chain lightning and shadow steps.

THE TRADE ROUTES — v9: every open workshop raises its own BUILDING on the guild ring, and the quarter grows into a real district: a TANNERY drying its hides, a WEAVER'S LOOM strung with cloth, a FIELD KITCHEN breathing stew-steam, a glowing ALCHEMY LAB, the ARTISAN FORGE and an ARCANE ATELIER with a crystal turning above the roof. Artisans take up posts at their benches and hammer while you watch. Foreign BUYING CARAVANS now walk the king's roads to the quarter — Valdorian factors, Karaz-Hul stewards and Akemi silk-mongers browse the benches and pay a PREMIUM for crafted goods (a famous +35% more for their kingdom's favorites). Thirteen NEW RECIPES deepen every branch: cheese wheels, fish feasts, fire oil, whetstones, road lanterns, fine plate, silk robes, saddlebags, ranger quivers, warding scrolls, crystal orbs, guild banners that raise reputation, and the ELIXIR OF THE HALL that heals every wounded hero at once. And the world no longer stops when you open a ledger — workshops, expeditions and buyers keep working BEHIND every panel.

THE AETHER AGE — v10: the sky itself joins the economy. An AETHER MAST rises on the guild ring at guild level 4, and soon the AETHERWIND — a striped merchant airship with spinning propellers and a coin-heavy hold — sails in from the FLOATING ISLES. It unloads exotic SKY CARGO (cloud sugar, storm salt, glowing sky coral, aether glass), buys your CRAFTED GOODS at the best premium in the realm, then casts off over the rooftops. At guild level 6 the SCHOLAR'S STUDY opens: fund NINE RESEARCH PROJECTS — guildseal rites, ledger automation, beacon signals, the buyer's banner, larder charms, harvest glyphs, the grand census, sky charts and aether wings — and each breakthrough permanently AUTOMATES and sharpens a piece of the realm. Out in the field, heroes who fight side by side forge BONDS: friendship levels that make bonded pairs faster and hit harder, with combo shouts and ballads sung in their names. And when the seasons turn, the plaza may erupt in the FESTIVAL OF THE HALL — lantern strings, dancing citizens and fireworks over the rooftops, +10 reputation and +8% morale for every hero.

THE ROYAL ARCHITECTURE — v14: the kingdoms stopped sprinkling huts and started building CITIES. Every capital now wears its own silhouette: VALDORIA raises GILDERKEEP, pale limestone under blue-slate cones and gold banners; KARAZ-HUL stacks THE IRON CITADEL, dark square stone with forge-glow windows and breathing chimneys; SAKURA-TO piles a three-tiered TENSHU castle in white plaster and red pillars; the hidden VELMORA crowns a MOON SPIRE with a crescent finial. Cities are PLANNED now, not sprinkled: the castle holds the high ground behind a flagstone court, the MARKET SQUARE keeps the crossroads, craft rows smith and smelt to the west, market rows bake and broker to the east, farm belts ripen along the south, and NOBLE MANORS flank the castle approach. GRAND TEMPLES ring their bells in every faith — chapel, ancestor hall, torii shrine — and can lift a curse. BARRACKS train the watch, granaries keep the grain dry, stables and gardens soften the streets, lamp posts light the boulevards, and cobbled STREETS run gate-to-gate. Capitals wear an octagonal WALL with towers on every corner and GATEHOUSES that open exactly where the king's roads demand; PORT CALYPSO lights a striped LIGHTHOUSE whose beam sweeps the dark. And the guild itself may one day raise its own ROYAL CASTLE on the city ring.

THE GRAND ARCHITECTURE — v15: the kingdoms were not satisfied with walls alone, and neither are you. Every ROYAL CASTLE is rebuilt as a true fortress complex — a barbican with raised portcullis and lowered drawbridge, curtain walls with mural walks, drum and square towers, a great hall under a rose window and a keep that owns the skyline (the guild keep now keeps its own hours with a clock). The CITY GATES grow drawbridges, iron grates and hanging lanterns; the WALLS grow plinths, arrow slits and ROUND MURAL TOWERS that watch the long mid-walls. The boulevard lays a pale spine of center stones, the market square wears radial bands and a granite rim, and a crimson RUNNER of stone carries you from gate to throne. TRIUMPH ARCHES span the boulevard with burning braziers, ROYAL BANNERS flank the castle court, HERO STATUES keep the plaza and the keep, ARMORIES rack spears beside every barracks, and the SCHOLAR’S STUDY opens in two capitals. Cottages learned to grow: timber TOWNHOUSES and moss-roofed stone cottages join the thatch. And the riverside town of THORNFIELD now keeps a true HARBOR — a plank pier, a moored merchant cog that bobs on the current, crates, a rowboat, a lantern for late landings and gulls wheeling over the masts.

THE SELF-RUNNING GUILD — v16: you manage NOTHING, Guild Master. The hall hires its own STAFF, and every duty of the guild becomes a character's job. The STEWARD keeps the contract board full and outfits expeditions when a slot sits idle. The RECRUITER walks the plaza and comes back with fresh talent. The TREASURER makes the tax rounds building by building — coin pops where she stands. The QUARTERMASTER hawks the surplus at the market stalls. The GUILD FACTOR reads the ledgers and invests the coffers — opening and expanding guild BUSINESSES, buying STAKES in the kingdom markets. The SCHOLARS choose their own research and fund it themselves. The HEALER mends the heroes who limp home. The MASTER-AT-ARMS drills the watch by the barracks — guards near his yard strike a third harder. They sleep at night, they work at dawn, they wear gold name tags when you walk close, and the CITY panel keeps a STAFF ROSTER of who is doing what this very second. Your only job is to roam the realm as its god.

THE LIVING ARCHITECTURE — v17: the realm stopped holding its breath. Every capital raises a GRAND MARKET HALL of ashlar and arcade in its square — a bell gable, dormered roof, striped lean-to stalls and lamplight that never quits. The WINDMILLS threw off their frozen sails: now they turn with the wind, each at its own pace, dusting flour from the air. Every hearth smokes — cottages, townhouses, manors — and their windows burn warm after dark. BIRDS wheel over the keeps and the mural towers. AVENUE TREES line the boulevards, the courts and the village greens (leaves let go on the autumn wind), WAYSIDE SHRINES keep their candles along the king's roads and beside every city gate, and each capital entrance gains a true FORECOURT — shade, lamplight and a quiet shrine where the road meets the stone. The districts wear their own ground now: soot-dark craft rows, pale temple gravel, sandy market walks, trodden farm earth. And where the king's road meets deep water, the plank ford is replaced by a GRAND STONE BRIDGE — arched piers standing in the current, keystone ribs, parapets with merlons and lanterns burning at both ends. The guild may raise every one of these itself as the city grows.

THE SPRAWLING REALM — v18: the kingdoms tore down their cramped old rings and drew breath. Every CAPITAL has grown half again as wide — walls now stand far out on the meadows, and inside them a true city PLAN: a 40-pace PROCESSIONAL WAY runs from the south gate to the castle court, crossed by a GRAND AVENUE; a plaza ring and an outer GRAND CIRCUIT are tied by four diagonal radials; the market quarter, craft quarter, temple close, noble row and two residential quarters each wear their own grid of lanes. HOUSES no longer scatter — they stand in TERRACE ROWS along the lanes, doors to the street, lamps and avenue trees pacing the way between. The SQUARE keeps its fountain, market hall and statues; farms line the southern ways; the crimson runner still climbs to the throne. Villages gained a planned HIGH STREET with a market cross, back lane and farm way. And the realm itself is a MESH now, not a chain — five new roads loop the kingdoms together (guild to Millbrook and Deephollow, Millbrook to Thornfield, Thornfield to Emberfall, Koiwara to the sea), every one a wandering curve, every crossing gated, every ford a stone bridge. The guild city sprawls wider every age to match.

THE HANDS-OFF REALM — v20: the god needs no levers. The G-mode toggle is gone — the guild master is TIER SSS by birthright, and every shop counter, upgrade anvil and stake ledger now belongs to the staff. The ASSISTANT MANAGER runs the whole hall in his name: she funds the guild tech, grows the businesses, hires exactly the adventurers the roster lacks, sends gather contracts for whatever the build site, larder and workshops actually need, and dispatches AGENTS down the king's roads to the foreign guilds — trust earned, champions unsealed, all without a click. TAP ANY NPC to open the eye upon that one life and watch the smith hammer, the baker knead, the smelter breathe fire at their benches. The river widened and learned new doors: HEROES NOW SWIM the slow way, and BOATMEN row water-taxis at two lantern landings for a small guild fare. The pathfinders stopped jostling — fires seat their campers in rings, ponds hand out private banks, stuck feet recover, and no one re-plans mid-bridge. The wilds filled in: forests and boulders across the whole realm, four new HAMLETS on the roads, WAYFARER CAMPS burning in the empty miles — and the realm's builders now EXTEND THEIR OWN LANDS, raising new roofs and opening true roads with fresh bridges between the settlements. The eagle buttons retired: two fingers do it all.

THE STEWARD'S LEDGER — v21: the realm learns its own name. Four biomes carry it now: VALORIA's green heart, the snow-scarred IRONPEAK HIGHLANDS, THE SHADOWFEN's moonlit fens and the golden SUNVEIL road south — the ground itself changes under your boots, and the HUD names the land you stand on. The harbor is PORT CALYPSO now. The screen was rebuilt for thumbs: ONE gear button gathers every system panel — city, status, map, gazette, spectate, sound, fullscreen — behind a single tap; score, best and the turning day sit top-center; the attack button keeps its big right-corner throne with dash and cry arcing above; and the green USE rises at bottom-center only when the world offers a hand. CELIA, THE GRAND STEWARD, signs her name to the hall — purple-gowned, gold-quilled, a songbird swinging at her hip — and tapping her opens THE STEWARD'S LEDGER: the whole guild's income, contracts, staff and foreign trust on one page, with AUDIT NOW, EXPEDITION BOOST and the STAFF ROSTER one tap away. When you roam too far, she closes the desk and WALKS THE LEDGER TO YOU. The monsters got smarter as well: they keep aggro tables against whoever bleeds them most, fan into surround slots instead of piles, rout together when panic spreads, and dodge harder against a master who spams the same trick — while your heroes answer in kind: support classes run FIELD TRIAGE on the lowest-blood ally and the shield wall INTERPOSES between threats and the backline. And the roads everyone walks are remembered — the waypoint ledger serves cached routes, so a crowded realm never stutters.

THE WATERWAYS & THE MANAGER — v19: the great river stopped being a wall. STEPPING-STONE FORDS cross the shallows at five places along its course — wet-topped stones, foam combs and guide posts on both banks — and every walker, beast and hero may wade through, splashing. THORNFIELD now keeps a ROPE FERRY: two lantern piers and a flat barge that walks a sagging rope bank to bank, carrying anyone aboard — heroes waiting politely at the pier, the guild master strolling on and off. And the realm's pathfinders grew a map brain: routes now PREFER THE KING'S ROADS (highway walkers, not wall-huggers), wade the fords when they are shorter, ride the ferry across a virtual rope-edge, and reach four times farther — heroes bound for the far kingdoms route the whole trek instead of giving up. Best of all, the hall's last job is done: the GUILD MANAGER walks the floors — rewinds the artisans when they stall, restocks the potion shelf and the larder, re-posts the contracts, inspects every officer (inspected staff work half again as fast), and finds you on the road with THE LEDGER: contracts done, coin ledgered, roofs raised, hands hired — ALL DELEGATED, MASTER.

HOW TO PLAY

◆ 1 · MOVETouch anywhere on the LEFT half — the stick rises under your thumb. Drag it to walk. Keyboard: WASD or arrows.
◆ 2 · FIGHTHOLD the big right button to auto-attack. DASH slides through danger, WAR CRY rallies every hero nearby, HERO recruits one more blade — watch the cooldown rings.
◆ 3 · THE EAGLE EYEPinch two fingers to soar above the realm — two fingers also drag the world. The + / − buttons by the map zoom too.
◆ 4 · GROWThe hall runs itself: the steward hires, builds, trades and sends agents. Tap any NPC to watch their life. The city saves itself.
